title: Generated code file for templated classes uses invalid XML format in `inheritdoc`
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.stable.mono.official.89cea1439

### System information

.NET SDK 10.0.104 on Linux with Rider 2026.1

### Issue description

When making a generic class that has Godot stuff in it, the generated file has invalid syntax in the XML comments which causes warnings.

For example, if I make my class `public partial class StrategicUnitScreen<T>` and put a signal in it, then the generated code gets this:

```c#
    /// <inheritdoc cref="global::StrategicUnitScreen<T>.OnOpenGodToolsEventHandler"/>
```

Which is not valid XML, and instead the code should look like:
```c#
    /// <inheritdoc cref="global::StrategicUnitScreen{T}.OnOpenGodToolsEventHandler"/>
```


So I think there's a small missing feature from the Godot source generator where `<>` in XML output should be escaped as `{}`.

### Steps to reproduce

A class definition like this should be enough to trigger the warning:

```c#
public partial class StrategicUnitScreen<T> : TopLevelContainer
    where T : GodotObject
{
    [Signal]
    public delegate void OnOpenGodToolsEventHandler(GodotObject unit);
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

It should be enough to just have a class file like above. If someone really wants to see me put that into a blank Godot project with just that one file, I'll just directly find out where the source generator is and make a PR.
